# P10: Golden Horde 1345/1355 Anti-Double-Collapse & Pax Janibeg Guard
# Expected full pass at 1337: 1111 (+1 GLH alive, +10 GLH ulus >= 1, +100 oe_ghh_janibeg_pax DB, +1000 oe_chgu_kernel_yearly)
oe_probe3_run_p10 = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p10 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:GLH }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p10 add = 1 }
		c:GLH = {
			if = {
				limit = { any_subject = { is_subject_type = oe_glh_ulus } }
				root = { change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p10 add = 10 } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ghh_janibeg_pax }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p10 add = 100 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ghh_janibeg_pax days = 2 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ghh_janibeg_pax }
			change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p10 add = 100 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_ghh_janibeg_pax
		}
	}
	oe_chgu_kernel_yearly = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_chgu_ran_y }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p10 add = 1000 }
	}
}

# P11: Chagatai 3-Wing Overhaul (FRG/OTR/BSB + 17 oe_chg_amir + East-West Split Readiness)
# Expected full pass at 1337: 1111 (+1 CHG alive, +10 FRG/OTR/BSB exist, +100 all 3 are oe_chg_amir of CHG, +1000 CHG has >= 17 amirs)
oe_probe3_run_p11 = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p11 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:CHG }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p11 add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:FRG
			country_exists = c:OTR
			country_exists = c:BSB
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p11 add = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:FRG = { is_subject_type = oe_chg_amir }
				c:OTR = { is_subject_type = oe_chg_amir }
				c:BSB = { is_subject_type = oe_chg_amir }
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p11 add = 100 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:CHG
			c:CHG = {
				any_subject = {
					count >= 17
					is_subject_type = oe_chg_amir
				}
			}
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p11 add = 1000 }
	}
}

		limit = {
			country_exists = c:MMD c:MMD = { country_type = building is_subject_type = oe_mam_niyabat }

# P16: Fourth Rome (ELR) Critical Bugfix, Elysian Senate & 75y 3-Tier Economic Curve
# Expected full pass: 1111 pre-exodus / 11111 on live ELR
#   (+1 oe_el4_kernel_yearly, +10 Stage 2 mod DB, +100 Stage 3 mod DB,
#    +1000 ELR Senate & tribal cleanup (or Stage 1 mod DB pre-exodus),
#    +10000 live ELR can_call_rural_parliaments = yes & oe_eln_ref_senatus_novae_elysiae)
oe_probe3_run_p16 = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p16 value = 0 }
	oe_el4_kernel_yearly = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_el4_ran_y }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p16 add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_el4_founded_t2_mod }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p16 add = 10 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_el4_founded_t2_mod days = 2 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_el4_founded_t2_mod }
			change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p16 add = 10 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_el4_founded_t2_mod
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_el4_founded_t3_mod }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p16 add = 100 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_el4_founded_t3_mod days = 2 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_el4_founded_t3_mod }
			change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p16 add = 100 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_el4_founded_t3_mod
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:ELR }
		c:ELR = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					parliament_type ?= parliament_type:oe_elysian_senate
					NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:haudenosaunee_clan_mothers }
					NOT = { has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:tribes_tribal_levies }
				}
				root = { change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p16 add = 1000 } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					modifier:can_call_rural_parliaments = yes
					has_reform = government_reform:oe_eln_ref_senatus_novae_elysiae
				}
				root = { change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p16 add = 10000 } }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		# Pre-exodus 1337 check: verify Stage-1 founding mod DB is loaded
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ely_nova_elysia_founded_mod }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p16 add = 1000 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ely_nova_elysia_founded_mod days = 2 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ely_nova_elysia_founded_mod }
			change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p16 add = 1000 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_ely_nova_elysia_founded_mod
		}
	}
	}
}

# P22: Module F 6 Civilization Parliaments, 24 Agendas, 10 Cabinet Actions & 27-Type Subject Lock
# Expected full pass: 111 (+1 oe_gov2_mod_pi_fra_taille DB, +10 27-type subject lock trigger alive on building & landed special subjects, +100 global kernel yearly dispatch ran)
oe_probe3_run_p22 = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p22 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_gov2_mod_pi_fra_taille }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p22 add = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_gov2_mod_pi_fra_taille days = 2 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_gov2_mod_pi_fra_taille }
			change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p22 add = 1 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_gov2_mod_pi_fra_taille
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_country = {
				country_type = building
				oe_is_protected_special_subject = yes
			}
			any_country = {
				NOT = { country_type = building }
				oe_is_protected_special_subject = yes
			}
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p22 add = 10 }
	}
	oe_chgu_kernel_yearly = yes
	oe_vic_kernel_yearly = yes
	oe_vs2_kernel_yearly = yes
	oe_sy2_kernel_yearly = yes
	oe_el4_kernel_yearly = yes
	oe_rc2_kernel_yearly = yes
	oe_as2_kernel_yearly = yes
	oe_dis2_kernel_yearly = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = oe_chgu_ran_y
			has_global_variable = oe_vic_ran_y
			has_global_variable = oe_vs2_ran_y
			has_global_variable = oe_sy2_ran_y
			has_global_variable = oe_el4_ran_y
			has_global_variable = oe_rc2_ran_y
			has_global_variable = oe_as2_ran_y
			has_global_variable = oe_dis2_ran_y
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe3_p22 add = 100 }
	}
}
